tools.name: preview_csharp_rename
tools.description: Preview Roslyn C# symbol rename changes without applying edits to the workspace or files.

newName.description: New C# identifier name for the target symbol.

symbolKey.description: Stable symbol key returned from a previous symbol query. Optional when source position is provided.

filePath.description: Source file path for position-based lookup. Optional when symbol key is provided.

line.description: One-based source line for position-based lookup.

column.description: One-based source column for position-based lookup.

renameOverloads.description: Whether Roslyn should rename overloads when supported for the symbol.

renameInStrings.description: Whether Roslyn should rename matching text inside string literals.

renameInComments.description: Whether Roslyn should rename matching text inside comments.

renameFile.description: Whether Roslyn should include file rename metadata when supported. The MCP tool still only previews and never applies changes.

maxTextChanges.description: Maximum number of text changes to include in the preview.

maxSnippetLength.description: Maximum old/new snippet length per text change.

includeGeneratedCode.description: Whether generated code should be included when the bridge supports it.

targetPipeName.description: Optional target Visual Studio bridge pipe name. Highest priority when provided.

targetInstanceId.description: Optional target Visual Studio bridge instance id.

targetSolutionPath.description: Optional target Visual Studio solution path.

tools.name: remove_debug_breakpoint
tools.description: Remove exactly one breakpoint by breakpoint name or absolute file path and line in the targeted Visual Studio instance. Requires an explicit target.

tools.name: review_csharp_change
tools.description: Create a read-only semantic review package for changed C# files or a focused symbol, including impact, risks, test gaps, temporary markers, and verification next actions.

tools.name: search_csharp_symbols
tools.description: Search C# symbols in the active Visual Studio solution and return file and line evidence.

tools.name: set_debug_breakpoint
tools.description: Set a source breakpoint by absolute file path and line in the targeted Visual Studio instance. Requires an explicit target.

tools.name: split_csharp_agent_work
tools.description: Split a C# objective into bounded child-agent work packets with file/symbol scope, allowed tools, budgets, and output schema.

tools.name: start_csharp_investigation
tools.description: Start a read-only C# investigation by combining bridge health, optional build-log triage, scoped diagnostics, symbol lookup, and related context.

tools.name: start_debugging
tools.description: Start debugging in the targeted Visual Studio instance. This mutates debugger state and requires an explicit target.

tools.name: step_into
tools.description: Step into from the current debugger frame in the targeted Visual Studio instance. Requires break mode and an explicit target.

tools.name: step_out
tools.description: Step out from the current debugger frame in the targeted Visual Studio instance. Requires break mode and an explicit target.

tools.name: step_over
tools.description: Step over the current debugger frame in the targeted Visual Studio instance. Requires break mode and an explicit target.

tools.name: stop_debugging
tools.description: Stop the debugger session in the targeted Visual Studio instance. This mutates debugger state and requires an explicit target.

tools.name: wait_for_artifact_evidence
tools.description: Wait for local report, trace, log, JSON, or text artifacts to appear, then collect compact evidence.

tools.name: wait_for_visual_studio_bridge
tools.description: Wait for a Visual Studio VSIX bridge discovery record that matches a .sln or .slnx path.

solutionPath.description: Absolute path to the .sln or .slnx file expected to be open in Visual Studio.

timeoutMilliseconds.description: Maximum time to wait for bridge discovery.

pollIntervalMilliseconds.description: Polling interval while waiting for bridge discovery.
